Illuminant Surgical is building a new way of seeing inside the human body.

Our breakthrough platform, Skylight, is the first real-time anatomical projection system, displaying images directly on the patient to give doctors an x-ray vision view for safer interventions.

aiResearchSummary.text: Systems for projection mapping and markerless registration for surgical and the described method for receiving data from an optical sensor to create a three dimensional virtual model of an operative field indicate that Illuminant Surgical is researching image guided visualization. They focus on real time optical sensing, virtual model generation, and projection mapping onto anatomy without markers to provide an enhanced way of seeing inside the human body across sensing, registration, and intraoperative visualization.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $4,200,000, or 47.19% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $4,200,000, representing 47.19% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,835,269 to $17,635,000, a 3.65x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
